invariants.rationale: Many hit detection routines expect a non-negative x coordinate as part of the visible area.
Hit calculations often consider positive coordinates for y as part of the valid input region.
The method checks whether x is within the width of the container, suggesting this is a domain invariant for hits.
The method checks whether y is within the height of the container, implying hits only occur when y is within this range.
The method returns early if touchable is true and getTouchable() is disabled, so this relationship may constrain valid hits.
